items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Yeah, we had real alto. Old man Bob Rand.

ctx.x: Emanuel Perez, Maurice Duran, and sometimes Ricard. But I can't remember the other regular member. No, but Ricard. I remember who the trombones were. Yank Johnson, and we used a guy called Gaia. You know the guy who used to play banjo? Butler rap. Yeah, butler rap. That's right. He played trombone. I didn't know that. Yeah, he played trombone in our brass band a long time.

They had alto horns or saxes or anything? Yeah, we had real alto. Old man Bob Rand. Oh yes. He played, and who baritone played? Tats Daddy. Oh yes, Alexander. Yeah, old man Alexander. Adolph, his name is Adolph.
Adolph Adolph Adolph, that's right. That's who played baritone with us. Who was this? And we had clarinet Joe Watson. You heard of Joe Watson clarinet player? We had him.
